issues.passage: The panel’s heterogeneity of views produced a unanimous vote with no dissent recorded.
issues.why: "Heterogeneity of views" is standard correct use (diverse opinions). Diverse views can still end in a unanimous vote after debate; the ironic outcome does not make the word wrong. A careful reader would accept the sentence as valid English.

fix.correctPassage: The city’s cultural heterogeneity is visible in its markets, languages, and festivals.
wrongPassages: Managers prized the product line’s heterogeneity: every unit matched the others exactly.
Genetic heterogeneity was confirmed once every sample proved identical to the control.
Tourists praised the district’s architectural heterogeneity after block after block of identical brick facades.
